codeReview.summary: The commit correctly adds a new cli-count-stream scenario group and run_matrix executes it, but the implementation does not satisfy the feature description claim that VAL-CLI-001..003 can be validated via run_matrix artifacts alone.

issues.description: `cli-count-stream` only adds multi-file scenarios (`count-matches`, `cli-default-multi-file`, `cli-nofilename`) and does not add a single-file filename-prefix scenario, but VAL-CLI-002 requires both single-file and multi-file prefix semantics.

No stdin/stream scenario was added for `cli-count-stream`, yet VAL-CLI-001 and VAL-CLI-003 explicitly include stream behavior. Validation contract still requires stream evidence, so run_matrix artifacts from this group cannot fully replace ad-hoc transcript checks.
The updated guidance states VAL-CLI-001..003 can be validated via `--group cli-count-stream` artifacts, which overstates coverage while stream semantics remain outside this group.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `rewrite-worker` mandates strict failing-test-first workflow, but this tooling/manifest task had no realistic red-test step before manifest edits. The worker flagged this mismatch in handoff feedback, indicating the skill procedure should explicitly cover manifest-only parity-group additions.

Shared testing guidance now implies full VAL-CLI-001..003 coverage via run_matrix group artifacts, but validation-contract still requires stdin stream semantics that run_matrix group scenarios do not encode.
